blocks.text: Check our Miss Universe 2026 live updates page to get the latest news and features Bea Millan Windorski expressed her gratitude to Filipinos for supporting her even as she finished third runner-up in the 2026 Miss Universe competition in Puerto Rico on Wednesday, Nov. 24 (25 in the Philippines). The Filipino-American climate activist and model took to Facebook following the coronation show to express how proud she is for representing the country in the international stage.
